title: Brother Victor pushed down an elevator shaft
place_text: Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, Park Avenue and 93rd Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: in which case they pushed him down an elevator shaft and broke his legs.

plain: In 1968, at the Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia at Park Avenue and 93rd Street in Manhattan, a man known as Brother Victor was pushed down an elevator shaft and had both legs broken, according to the writer Peter Levenda. Levenda tells Michels this as something from his own time around the church, without saying clearly who "they" were who did it, and it is told as a sign of how dangerous that world could be.
